Privacy Policy

Last updated: June 2025

Data Processing

AGBInsights processes your data files entirely within your browser. Your spreadsheet data is never uploaded to our servers or stored in the cloud.

AI Analysis

When you use AI features, a summary of your data structure (column names and aggregated values) is sent to Anthropic's Claude API for analysis. Raw row-level data is not transmitted. Anthropic's privacy policy applies to these interactions.

Authentication

Account authentication is handled by Supabase. We store your email address and session token only. No payment information is collected.

Local Storage

User preferences, dashboard layouts, and recent file names are stored in your browser's localStorage. This data never leaves your device.

Contact

For privacy inquiries: contact@agbinsights.com

Security

Your data security is our priority.

Zero Upload Architecture

All data processing happens client-side in your browser using JavaScript. Your files are never transmitted to AGBInsights servers.

AI API Security

AI requests are proxied through a secure Vercel serverless function. Your Anthropic API key is never exposed in client-side code.

Authentication

Powered by Supabase with encrypted sessions and secure token management. Passwords are never stored in plain text.

Formula Safety

Calculated columns use a sandboxed arithmetic parser — no arbitrary code execution is possible.
